name: TN-06
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strongly Republican district (R+13 PVI) with no incumbent on the ballot
Huge fundraising gap: Garrett raised $2.4M vs Croley's $35K
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~94%
No public polling of the general election
model.rationale: The R+13 district and an overwhelming fundraising advantage for Johnny Garrett make a Democratic upset implausible, and markets agree at roughly 94% Republican. With no polls and an open seat, uncertainty is somewhat elevated, but the evidence points to a comfortable Republican hold.
model.watch: Any late polling showing the Democrat within single digits, or a major outside-spending surge, would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: John Rose (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Tennessee's 6th District is an open Republican-held seat after John Rose retired to run for governor. The Republican nominee, Johnny Garrett, has raised about $2.4 million and holds a large cash advantage, while Democrat Mike Croley has raised only about $35,000 with minimal cash on hand. No independent or outside groups are meaningfully engaged on the Democratic side.

Prediction markets put the Republican's chances near 94%, and no public general-election polls are available. The district's Republican lean of about 13 points makes this a safe Republican seat in expectation, with modest uncertainty from the open-seat dynamic and absence of polling.
